body.name: Refitted arm-vector \(m\)-out-of-\(n\) procedure
body.construction: Choose \(m\to\infty\) with \(m/n\to0\). Conditionally on the observed full sample \(O_1,\ldots,O_n\), draw \(B\) according to \(\mathbb P_B\), uniformly over all subsets of \(\{1,\ldots,n\}\) having cardinality \(m\). For every realized \(B\), refit all folds, generalized-inverse scales, order-statistic clips, preliminary quantiles, endpoint corrections, and densities. For \(a\in\mathcal A\) and \(\tau\in\mathcal T\), set \(V_{B,a}(\tau)=m\widehat H_{a,m,B}^{-1}\{\widehat q_{a,B}^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)-\widehat q_a^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)\}\), set \(T_{B,n}(\tau)=\widehat\ell_{1,n}V_{B,1}(\tau)-\widehat\ell_{0,n}V_{B,0}(\tau)\), and define \(c_{n,p}(\tau)=\inf\{t\in\mathbb R:\mathbb P_B\{T_{B,n}(\tau)\le t\mid O_1,\ldots,O_n\}\ge p\}\). Thus the conditional law is the complete uniform empirical subsampling measure; conditionally independent draws from \(\mathbb P_B\) give its Monte Carlo approximation.
inputs: a conditional uniform randomizer over size-\(m\) subsets, or exact enumeration of all such subsets
